title: real demo
description: aims to make the demo look like the real game
body:
this project aims to make the (java edition) **demo** look like the **real game**!

here are a few examples of what it does:

> removes the time limit text!
(no image for this one, how can i show it if i removed it, also the time limit will still be there)

> changes all the names in chat to "itsnotalex5" (u can change it, idm, its in en_us.json)
![shows a minecraft message that says "is this cool?" "probably not" with the names being itsnotalex5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2141b9b41a15dd1e5bcf758add58641ac2f18ebb.png)

> changes the menu up a bit to replicate the real one
![minecraft menu buttons with "minecraft realms" missing](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/049c97ff865990e03d12ffdaade49b665778f2f5.png)

> removes most of the warning when u enter ur world
![2 buttons, one says "not play" and the second says "play"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95df49f64d2a4b60754a91c7d009bc8e5748e9a9.png)

also all of this only works for US english
and i have no idea what even happens if u try this in the full game
